standIns.replacedBy: Fictional local parties, each with its own pinned identity key and aggregate keys. Joint computation uses the research-grade, unaudited sparq-aggregate/1 method.

Contributing organisations are fictional local parties with their own identity and aggregate keys. Real cryptographic evidence is checked by the research-grade, unaudited sparq-verifiable-aggregate package (61989f5). The verified roster excludes compute-only slots. The remaining count is an upper bound because a slot that can contribute may still commit zero. The package cannot yet prove that a slot committed a non-empty input.

assurance.assumption: Research-grade and unaudited. An input stays hidden from a coalition missing at least one other party, beyond what totals and its own inputs reveal; contributors can reconstruct both totals, including on refusal or a threshold verdict.
